question: I81
title: generation readout policy on v47 (32000 cells + step pinned): greedy vs genTemp=1 vs gate margin 0.2 at book30k, plus genTemp=1 at book300k; distinct4 / nonSpace / triBits; fresh k 2952-2959

accept.note: Plateau closed (y240): length parked, focus generation. Box smoke (R115) and historical z06: greedy loops / space-collapses at book30k; T1 and gate margin 0.2 were the useful policy levers (I81). Does either lift distinct4 / nonSpace on v47 at the known failure point (8 growths, paired)? The book300k T1 arm keeps queue depth >=12h with y241+y242 and asks whether sampling still helps after a life where the step fires (compare directionally to y242 greedy@300k on k 2944-2951). If neither policy beats greedy on distinct4 / nonSpace, generation needs a new idea (anti-repeat / larger prime), not more learning length.
